title: Molecularly guided buried-interface regulation for efficient and stable inverted perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05094D, Paper
Quanzhou Li, Min Wang, Liang Li
Molecularly guided buried-interface engineering prevents Al2O3 nanoparticle aggregation, optimized interface contact, and passivates defects, enabling perovskite solar cells with 26.63% efficiency and exceptional operational stability.
